_readme: Every photo the site uses is listed here. 'file' is a file in /photos. 'crop' (optional) is [left, top, right, bottom] as fractions of the original. 'caption' and 'credit' are optional and shown under the photo when set. Run `npm run build` after changing anything.

hero.alt: Looking down from the upper level of a packed arena glowing amber, a J. Cole Fall-Off Tour towel held up in the foreground.

crowd-entrance.alt: Black-and-white photo of J. Cole rapping from the middle of the crowd, surrounded by fans holding up phones, with only his face and hand in warm colour.

journey-2019._note: Optional. Add a photo from Nepal around 2019 to /photos and set its file name and alt text here to show it in place of the illustration (src/nepal-2019.svg). While 'file' is empty, the illustration is shown.

journey-2026.alt: Blue stage lights cut through a packed arena as J. Cole walks across a stage set with a parked car, the crowd holding up phones below.

live.alt: J. Cole alone in a single spotlight on a dark stage, singing into a standing microphone, his face shown large on the screen above.

night-1.alt: Phone lights scattered like stars across a dark arena, hands raised in the crowd below.

night-2.alt: A crowd under shafts of blue light, looking up toward the stage.

night-3.alt: The whole arena from above, every tier full, the stage glowing orange in the haze.

card-love-yourz.alt: A saved lyric card from "Love Yourz" by J. Cole: "It's beauty in the struggle, ugliness in the success."

card-change.alt: A saved lyric card from "Change" by J. Cole: "I know you desperate for a change, let the pen glide / But the only real change come from inside."
